---
title: "Run the Pipeline"
---

## Pull the pipeline

```bash
nextflow pull nf-core/rnaseq
```

## Run a test profile

Start with the built-in test profile before using your own data:

```bash
nextflow run nf-core/rnaseq \
  -profile test,docker \
  --outdir results/test
```

If you use Apptainer:

```bash
nextflow run nf-core/rnaseq \
  -profile test,apptainer \
  --outdir results/test
```

## Run your own samples

```bash
nextflow run nf-core/rnaseq \
  -profile docker \
  --input samplesheet.csv \
  --outdir results/rnaseq \
  --genome GRCh38
```

## Resume an interrupted run

```bash
nextflow run nf-core/rnaseq \
  -profile docker \
  --input samplesheet.csv \
  --outdir results/rnaseq \
  --genome GRCh38 \
  -resume
```

::: {.callout-warning}
Use the same command with `-resume`. Changing key parameters can invalidate cached work.
:::

## Record the exact command

Keep a copy of the final command in your notes or repository:

```bash
mkdir -p logs
nextflow run nf-core/rnaseq -profile docker --input samplesheet.csv --outdir results/rnaseq --genome GRCh38 2>&1 | tee logs/rnaseq.log
```
